axes.name: +1/+1 counters and counters matter
axes.definition: Puts +1/+1 counters (or any counters, including charge counters) on your creatures or permanents, or doubles counters, feeding payoffs that reward creatures or permanents with counters on them.

axes.name: Spacecraft and station
axes.definition: Is a Spacecraft, puts charge counters on Spacecraft, or tutors, recurs or protects Spacecraft, feeding payoffs that trigger on casting or controlling Spacecraft or on charge counters.

axes.name: Tapping your own creatures
axes.definition: Taps your own creatures outside of attacking (station, tap-two or tap-three costs, mana abilities) or untaps them to tap again, feeding creatures with 'whenever this becomes tapped' triggers.

axes.name: Artifact creatures and Borg
axes.definition: Is an artifact creature (Borg, Construct, Android, Illusion token, assimilated creature, stationed Spacecraft) or makes artifact creature tokens, feeding lords and payoffs that count or grant abilities to artifact creatures.

axes.name: Cheap noncreature spells
axes.definition: Is a cheap instant, sorcery, enchantment, Equipment or Spacecraft you cast, feeding Scientist-style payoffs that trigger whenever you cast a noncreature spell.

axes.name: Face a dilemma (modal spells)
axes.definition: Is a modal spell or has a 'choose one' modal ability (enters triggers, attack triggers, land triggers), so casting or triggering it makes you face a dilemma for dilemma payoffs.

axes.name: Dies triggers and sacrifice
axes.definition: Provides expendable bodies (hasty Klingon Warrior, Officer or Borg tokens, creatures that want to die) or a sacrifice outlet, feeding payoffs that trigger whenever a creature dies or reward sacrificing.

axes.name: Klingons
axes.definition: Is a Klingon or creates Klingon Warrior tokens, feeding cards that pump, target or reward sacrificing Klingons.

axes.name: Command: total power 8 and going wide
axes.definition: Adds power to your board cheaply, via Officer or other creature tokens, anthems, high-power bodies or pump, so that attacks with total power 8 or greater turn on the command payoffs.

axes.name: Landfall and extra lands
axes.definition: Puts lands onto the battlefield beyond the normal drop or more often (land tutors to battlefield, Planet tokens, extra land drops, land-to-hand effects that keep drops flowing), feeding landfall triggers.

axes.name: Strange new worlds (land names)
axes.definition: Is a nonbasic land with its own name (Planet, Anomaly, dual land), creates New Planet tokens, or tutors Planets, raising the count of differently named lands for strange new worlds cards.

axes.name: Filling the graveyard
axes.definition: Puts cards into your graveyard (surveil, mill, looting, discard, self-sacrifice), feeding reanimation, cast-from-graveyard, beam me up and threshold payoffs.

axes.name: Cards leaving the graveyard
axes.definition: Removes cards from your graveyard (beam me up casting, exile-from-graveyard costs, graveyard-to-hand or battlefield recursion, graveyard exile effects), feeding payoffs that trigger whenever a card leaves your graveyard.

axes.name: Enters effects and self-bounce
axes.definition: Is a creature with a valuable enters ability, or an effect that returns, flickers or re-casts your own permanents, so beam me up costs and self-bounce turn into repeated value.

axes.name: Federation (creature type diversity)
axes.definition: Adds distinct creature types among non-Borg creatures you control (multi-type creatures, changeling copies, named tokens of unusual types), feeding Federation payoffs that count creature types.
